meta.subject: fixed cache bypaas bug and refactoring

en.summary: Fixes a real non-cacheable bypass correctness bug in the cache path, primarily by preserving NC tag metadata and decoding the returned bypass word correctly; the commit also includes broad cache refactoring.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes a cache bypass bug.
The patch changes central cache RTL, including non-cacheable bypass tag packing/unpacking and one bank read-enable condition.
The modified tag widths and response slicing directly affect which requester and which word an uncached response returns to.
disqualifiers: The commit also performs a large cache wrapper refactor, so the entry should stay at medium confidence and focus on the clearly grounded bypass bug mechanism.
evidence: VX_define.vh adds NC_TAG_BITS to multiple cache MEM_TAG_WIDTH definitions, showing the old memory tag width was not carrying all required bypass metadata.
VX_nc_bypass.sv rewrites memory-tag insertion/removal and changes both request word-select extraction and response word-select extraction to use the NC-removed tag domain.

VX_bank.sv additionally changes the data-array read enable from do_read_st1 || do_mshr_st1 to (do_read_st1 && !miss_st1) || do_mshr_st1, indicating an auxiliary cache-path correctness fix in the same commit.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache that supports non-cacheable or bypassed accesses must preserve enough tag metadata to identify that the transaction is uncached, which requester issued it, and which subword inside a wider memory beat should be returned. If the bypass path truncates or mis-decodes those fields, an uncached response can be routed to the wrong requester, extract the wrong word from a cache-line-sized beat, or be mistaken for normal cache traffic.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: non-cacheable bypass tag packing and word-select decode
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Non-cacheable or passthrough accesses on a cache interface wider than the core word, especially with multiple request sources sharing the bypass path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove or inconsistently transport the bypass/NC discriminator and word-select bits through the memory tag, then decode the response using the wrong tag domain.
portability_notes: Map this to any cache, LSU, or memory front-end that multiplexes cached and uncached traffic over one external memory interface.
The key requirement is a tag format that must carry both requester identity and subword position for bypassed accesses.
Recreating the bypass-tag bug does not require reverting the entire cache refactor; a localized tag-pack/unpack regression is sufficient.
concrete_injection_steps: Reduce the memory tag width or omit the explicit uncached/bypass discriminator bit from the external memory tag format.
Pack the bypass request tag without all of requester index, subword select, and request identifier, or remove one of those fields before sending the memory request.
On the return path, slice the response word using raw tag bits from the wrong tag representation, instead of first removing the bypass/NC bit and then decoding requester index and word select.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Non-cacheable bypass tag width definition and tag pack/unpack logic; secondary bank read-enable guard
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds NC_TAG_BITS to cache memory-tag widths, rewrites VX_nc_bypass to insert/remove the NC bit consistently and decode word select from the NC-removed tag, and also gates one bank data-array read on !miss_st1.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the bypass path, remove the added NC tag bit from MEM_TAG width/packing and revert response word-select extraction to the older raw-tag indexing scheme; optionally also restore the old VX_bank read-enable predicate if reproducing the wider pre-fix state.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Uncached accesses can return the wrong word or wrong tag, be delivered to the wrong requester, or hang because bypass responses no longer match the request metadata correctly.
evidence_for_injection: The fix simultaneously changes tag width macros and the logic that inserts/removes the NC bit, which is exactly the kind of metadata-path repair expected for a bypass routing bug.
Both request-side word-select extraction and response-side word-select extraction are corrected in VX_nc_bypass.sv.
The commit subject explicitly names a bypass bug, and the touched files are central cache RTL files rather than tests or build scripts.
notes: The bank read-enable fix in VX_bank.sv appears to be a secondary co-fix in the same commit; the primary portable injection target is the bypass tag path.
Because the patch is large, this entry intentionally avoids claiming more than the code directly supports.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache 路径中真实存在的 non-cacheable bypass 正确性问题，核心是保留 NC tag 元数据并正确解码返回的 bypass word；同时该提交也包含较大范围的 cache 重构。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 cache bypass bug。
补丁修改了核心 cache RTL，包括 non-cacheable bypass 的 tag 打包/解包，以及一个 bank 的读使能条件。
被修改的 tag 位宽和响应切片逻辑会直接影响 uncached 响应最终返回给哪个 requester、以及取回哪个 word。
disqualifiers: 该提交同时进行了较大的 cache wrapper 重构，因此本条目保持 medium 置信度，并且只聚焦代码中证据最明确的 bypass bug 机制。
evidence: VX_define.vh 在多个 cache 的 MEM_TAG_WIDTH 定义中加入了 NC_TAG_BITS，说明旧的 memory tag 宽度没有携带完整的 bypass 元数据。
VX_nc_bypass.sv 重写了 memory tag 的插入/去除逻辑，并且把请求侧和响应侧的 word-select 提取都改成基于“去除 NC 位之后”的 tag 域。
VX_bank.sv 还把数据阵列的读使能从 do_read_st1 || do_mshr_st1 改成 (do_read_st1 && !miss_st1) || do_mshr_st1，表明同一提交里还有一个辅助的 cache-path 正确性修复。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 支持 non-cacheable 或 bypass 访问的 cache，必须在 memory tag 中保留足够的元数据，用来区分该事务是 uncached、由哪个 requester 发起，以及在更宽的 memory beat 中应返回哪个子字。如果 bypass 路径把这些字段截断或解码错误，uncached 响应就可能返回给错误的 requester、从 cache-line 宽 beat 中取出错误的 word，或者被误当成普通 cache 流量。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: non-cacheable bypass 的 tag 打包与 word-select 解码
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: cache 接口宽于 core word，且多个请求源共享 bypass 路径时发生 non-cacheable 或 passthrough 访问。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在 memory tag 里移除 bypass/NC 标志位或不一致地传递它，同时在响应侧基于错误的 tag 域进行解码。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 截断 bypass tag 元数据
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把 cached 与 uncached 流量复用到同一外部 memory 接口上的 cache、LSU 或 memory 前端。
关键前提是 tag 格式必须同时携带 requester 身份和 bypass 访问的子字位置。
复现该类 bypass-tag bug 不需要回退整个 cache 重构；局部回退 tag pack/unpack 即可。
concrete_injection_steps: 缩减 memory tag 位宽，或从外部 memory tag 格式中去掉显式的 uncached/bypass 区分位。
构造 bypass 请求 tag 时，不再完整保留 requester index、subword select 和 request identifier 中的一项或多项。
在返回路径上，不先去掉 bypass/NC 位就直接使用原始 tag 位切片返回数据，而不是先进入正确的 tag 域再解码 requester index 和 word select。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Non-cacheable bypass 的 tag 位宽定义与 tag 打包/解包逻辑；以及辅助的 bank 读使能保护
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为 cache memory-tag 宽度加入 NC_TAG_BITS，重写 VX_nc_bypass 以一致地插入/去除 NC 位并从去除 NC 位后的 tag 中解码 word select，同时还给 VX_bank 的一个数据阵列读使能增加了 !miss_st1 门控。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 bypass 路径中去掉新增的 NC tag 位宽/打包逻辑，并把响应 word-select 提取改回旧的“直接按原始 tag 切片”方式；如果需要复现更宽泛的修复前状态，可额外恢复 VX_bank 旧的读使能谓词。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: uncached 访问可能返回错误的 word 或错误的 tag，送到错误的 requester，或者因为 bypass 响应无法与请求元数据正确匹配而挂起。
evidence_for_injection: 修复同时改动了 tag 位宽宏定义以及 NC 位插入/去除逻辑，这正是 bypass 路由 bug 常见的元数据修复方式。
VX_nc_bypass.sv 中请求侧和响应侧的 word-select 提取都被纠正了。
提交标题明确点名 bypass bug，而且被修改的是核心 cache RTL 文件，不是测试或构建脚本。
notes: VX_bank.sv 中的读使能修复看起来是同一提交中的次级 co-fix；主要的可移植注入目标仍然是 bypass tag 路径。
由于补丁很大，本条目有意避免做出超出代码证据范围的过度推断。
